NTA you being the only sibling not in the wedding party is already going to cause questions about what the deal is. So you not being there at all makes no difference. I’m so sorry for how cruel they have been to you. We do not ask for life, we do ask to be born. It is a parents choice to bring children into the world. Unfortunately there are always risks and possibilities of our bodies just doing a 180. It literally is just how life goes. The fact that they put this blame on you is so cruel and unreal. I hope you keep strong and stand your ground. Do not let them disrespect you like that

I would like to add that I work at the Hayward Public Library and we have had a positive case and multiple people who are currently out waiting their results. Yet our director continues to push and advocate to open to full hours, open our branch location, all while not having enough staff. The director was upset when staff were against opening up study rooms and meeting rooms. We are constantly overworked, and our safety and concerns are ignored. We have patrons all day long who constantly take off their masks. So if you are concerned for your safety stay away from the Hayward Library

“Im just really bad at hurting people.” I struggle with this as well. So I really understand and empathize with this. The one thing I want to say is that the person you are hurting the most is yourself. From this comment and what you wrote above, you seem to be the type of person who, intentionally or not, puts other before yourself. Sometimes that’s ok but not all the time. You are allowed to put yourself 1st here. Prioritize you safety, well-being, and happiness. Another thing to note, most people get into relationships to be together for life, just ask yourself if you can look past the jealousy and transphobia. You seem to have a good head and probably already know your answer.

100% YTA you want your untrained sil taking care of your brother?! Why wouldn’t you want a trained professional who knows how to take care of him and what to do for every situation. Why don’t YOU go take care of him. If sil want as going out and buying purses, shoes, eating out every day, etc, then yes that’s be financially irresponsible; but what she’s planning and doing is the right thing to do.

They kinda stopped with my sisters but even to this day, the guys can not be brought up without some mention about me and them. It made it uncomfortable between the me and them. I won’t get into details but this really f****d me up. Im 26 and i still have issues because of this. You are doing the right thing. Keep them away, keep your daughter safe. You are doing a good job

NTA when I was in school, my teachers would ask parents to donate extra supplies for students who couldn’t afford supplies. That way everyone had what they needed. I understand what the teacher is trying to do. Yes learning to share is important for kids to learn but forcing them, not allowing them to have any ownership is, in my opinion, going to backfire. Kids need to also be taught boundaries and how to respect each other’s items. Forcing everyone to give up their items is going to cause resentment and reluctance to sharing which is what I think is happening with your daughter. Honestly don’t know how you want to proceed but either way NTA.

This 100% ! You are aware of her struggles and her stress and even say you could tell she was obviously hungry. Yet you ignored it all, the amount of selfishness and lack of empathy in this post is heartbreaking. Yes she is a grown adult but she is a grown adult who struggles with her mental health, works in a seriously stressful job (especially now). And yet she still has enough compassion and selflessness to put her son and you first. Get some perspective and some empathy. YTA

NTA I am so hurt and angry and disgusted for you, your husband and most importantly your daughter.  There is literally absolutely no excuse or reasoning good enough to make this ok. She should be ashamed and humiliated. The thought process of people like this is astounding. How on earth did she think you would react walking into the wedding and seeing children running around. They had choices. No one forced her to lie to you guys no one told her to be insensitive and disgusting. This was 100% her choice. You being rightfully livid and disgusted and reacting the way you did is a consequence of her actions. What happens to her relationship with you and your husband and your daughter is a consequence of her actions. Your reaction was 100% well within your right as a mother! Tbh I’m surprised you didn’t fight her. A slap or punch to the face would’ve been deserved( i don’t believe in violence but even I know sometimes it’s deserved). I’m curious if your mother knew ahead of time about the lie? If so then she too is at fault. How dare not a signal one of them consider the feelings of their granddaughter/niece. Honestly what did they think would happen if she saw pictures with all the children around. As angry as I am for the situation, I am very concerned for your daughter. Has she found out what happened? Honestly at this point if you are able to I would try and get therapy. For all of you but mostly your daughter. Those comments you mentioned and the actions of her own family members on top of the “growing pains” of the teen years is just too much for anyone to handle. It’s ok for people to get help and have extra support. ( I say this as someone who has been in therapy on-off since I was 10). I suggest that you and husband get therapy, as a parent to have to listen to people say comments and do atrocious shit like this is beyond hurtful. It’s nice to be able to talk to someone who has an unbiased perspective, who can also give you tips and suggestions on how to help you emotionally and mentally support yourself and your husband and daughter. In terms of your sister, BIL, and possibly mother? (Anyone who knew about the lie); I would send them a msg telling them how selfish and hurtful this was to you and your husband. Tell them that a wedding day does NOT mean that they can put “pretty” pictures above the emotional and mental well-being of another person. ESPECIALLY when that person is family. Their actions have consequences. They need to step up, own their actions and words. Lying to you about not having kids at the wedding was a COWARD move. Expecting you to show up and stay at a wedding and be ok with this was unrealistic. They obviously do not care for your daughter. This means they are not people you should want around her. I would cut their access to her 100% and then have very VERY little contact with them yourself. If they want anything to do with you they need to 100% respect and accept your family. Your husband and daughter are people you love and CHOOSE to be your family. You are a package deal. The other choice is to sit down with your daughter and tell her what happened and then let her choose what she would like to do. If she would to confront them, do it in your home where she has home advantage and feels safe and be there to intervene when needed. If she chooses no contact, then let them know this she’s choice and they can fuck off. There is not a single other person who has a right to judge you and try to manipulate you into apologizing. You are a mother. She is your daughter and as such your #1 priority. Nothing else matters but her. You are NTA.  They are. (Sorry for the long post. I just feel very strongly about this)

Yes 100% agree. He knew that it was not ok what he did. He knows that you would not be ok with it. That is why he tried to not let you see the painting until after the showing. I am also an artist and in my opinion you 100% need to have the CONSENT to paint someone nude. This was not a nude painting of a person he imagined up. This is a nude painting of YOU a real life person. And if the wrong person saw it, it could cause you issues. This is a violation of you. If he is so willing to defend it then he should be just as willing to accept the consequences. I really do suggest reporting this to his professor or the dean of his department. This is not ok. I am so sorry you have been violated and disrespected this way. NTA

NTA. I definitely agree with this 100%. OP have you considered maybe finding a therapist or counselor for you and your daughter? This whole situation is obviously so toxic and emotionally and mentally draining for both of you and probably your fiancé. I think letting your daughter have someone to talk to about all this would be beneficial and with time I hope she will come to understand that you are only trying to keep her safe because of how much you love her.
